requirements: R1: Modify the PR closed status sync logic to correctly revert the internal task status to 'failed' rather than retaining the 'done' status when an unmerged PR is closed.
R2: Update the testSyncTaskStatusesDoesNotPerformRedundantUpdatesOnSubsequentRuns to correctly assert that the status is reverted to 'failed'.

slices.title: Fix PR closed status sync logic and assert failure reversion
slices.jtbd: When implementing the PR status sync fix for this epic, I want to properly revert unmerged closed PRs to 'failed' and update the corresponding test, so that tasks are not falsely marked as done.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unmerged PR is closed, When the status sync logic runs, Then the task status must be set to 'failed'.
Given the testSyncTaskStatusesDoesNotPerformRedundantUpdatesOnSubsequentRuns runs, When checking the task status, Then it must assert the status is 'failed'.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce falsely 'done' tasks from closed-unmerged PRs to 0.

epics.title: Self-Falsification Audit and Planning Pipeline Fixes
epics.jtbd: When the system operator audits specifications and plans tasks, I want the system to accurately report gaps, enforce strict TOC rules, and use Explanatory Coherence to detect duplicates, so that false success and redundant planning cycles are eliminated.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce false success coverage claims and duplicate PR plans to 0.
epics.tocConstraintRef: Task plan generation and validation pipeline
requirements: R1: Patch coverage audit and task planning generators to accurately report specification gaps instead of returning empty arrays and false completions.
R2: Enforce TOC refusal criteria in planning services to reject qualitative bottleneck phrases in favor of explicit constraints.
R3: Integrate Explanatory Coherence (ECHO) evaluation to actively detect and halt identical duplicate task planning cycles.

slices.title: Patch planning services for gap reporting, TOC validation, and ECHO coherence
slices.jtbd: When fixing the planning and audit services for this epic, I want to implement gap reporting, TOC enforcement, and ECHO evaluation, so that false successes and duplicate cycles are automatically rejected.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a coverage audit for an unaddressed specification, When generated, Then it must report accurate gaps.
Given a task plan with qualitative TOC phrases or identical duplicates, When validated, Then the system must reject it using ECHO coherence.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Task plan generation and validation pipeline
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce false success coverage audits and duplicate task plans to 0.

slices.title: Verify planning service fixes for gap reporting, TOC validation, and ECHO
slices.jtbd: When testing the planning service patches for this epic, I want to verify the gap reporting, TOC validation, and ECHO coherence, so that I can ensure the system correctly rejects stubs and duplicate plans.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the patched planning services, When integration tests run with mock unaddressed specifications, Then the tests must assert accurate gap reporting.
Given mock task plans with qualitative TOC phrases or duplicates, When tested, Then the tests must assert rejection.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Task plan generation and validation pipeline
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Achieve 100% test coverage for gap reporting, TOC validation, and ECHO logic.
